title: The Buried Sled
text: A sled sticks out of a drift, its runners black with frost, its dogs frozen solid in their traces with their heads down against a wind that stopped long ago. The load is still lashed down tight. The driver is nowhere to be seen.

options.label: Dig out the frozen load. The driver will not be needing it.

outcomes.text: Beneath the lashings lie iron and thick furs. The furs smell of the dead dogs but keep out the cold.
The drift shifts and slides, burying you to the chest as it buried them.

options.label: The kindest buries the frozen dogs first, as they deserve.

outcomes.text: Under the last dog, curled against its belly, lies the driver's purse. He must have trusted the dog more than his sled.

options.label: The best tracker reads where the driver went, and what made him leave his dogs.

outcomes.text: He staggered toward the hills. Something followed, walking in his footprints step for step.
